out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw ground beef above ready to eat food in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. During inspection, PIC relocated ready to eat foods away from raw items to avoid contamination.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: dishes, equipment from dish machine with 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized all dishes and equipment at 3 compartment sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed espresso cleaner stored with clean dishes and equipment.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC placed espresso cleaner in designated storage.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed bowl, deli containers used as scoops to dispense dry goods.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed in use utensils. The Falls (Inspection Date: 04/30/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted technician for repair and set up 3 compartment sink during inspection. Once repair is completed, please submit invoice and photo of chlorine test strip with appropriate sanitizer concentration to EHS within 10 days.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. Observed live pest during inspection. Facility self-closed during inspection and pest control technician arrived and treated for cockroaches. Restaurant re-opened prior to the end of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: PIC voluntarily closed facility during inspection due to imminent health hazard. Imminent health hazard addressed during inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the dish machine being used to store a wiping cloth.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Employee removed wet wiping cloth from hand sink. The Falls (Inspection Date: 11/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Package Integrity
violations.observation: The following food item(s) from damaged packaging were found offered for sale or service: observed dented cans not segregated in dry storage.
violations.corrective_action: Food packages such as canned goods shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants. Return all dented and damaged canned goods to your food supplier for a credit. PIC segregated dented cans from non-dented cans.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell egg stored in bowl with avocado in 1 DR prep at cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Employee relocated raw shell egg below avocado.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Observed live cockroach on dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PIC contacted pest control during inspection for immediate service. Pest control technician arrived during inspection and treated affected areas.

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the back door.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. Please obtain a door sweep at the back door before next routine inspection.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed bowls used as scoop to dispense salt and pepper, various spices; observed beverage container used as scoop for kung pao dressing in walk in cooler; observed deli containers used as scoop to dispense flour.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed all bowls, cups, and deli containers used as scoops to dispense food items. Please obtain additional scoops with handles if necessary.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed employee drinking at back kitchen prep station.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC corrected staff and trained all staff on approved and designated locations for eating and drinking.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the hand sink on the left of the bar being used as a dump sink and to store strainers.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed items from sink and designated the single compartment sink on the right side of the bar as a dump sink. Please ensure that at least one sink is designated as a hand sink and the other is designated as a dump sink. The Falls (Inspection Date: 06/06/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: flash fried French fries (74F after 2 hours) on speed rack in back kitchen prep space.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded French fries.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: hot brine pickled vegetables in walk in cooler marked 4/9 and 5/24.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC discarded pickled vegetables.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Pink Pony Club cocktail (includes whipped unpasteurized egg white)
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC provided disclosure for all drinks with raw shell egg as an ingredient.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Observed container of “Ortho Home Defense” in back mop sink area.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. PIC removed residential use pesticide from establishment.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: ice scoop handle in contact with consumable ice in bar ice bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked freekeh (54F), roasted carrot (54F) in 2 dr prep (R) on cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded freekeh and carrot.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 dr prep (R) on cook line (45F).
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC contacted refrigerator repair technician during inspection. PIC will discontinue use of unit for storage of TCS items until unit is able to maintain an ambient temperature of 41F or below.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Main chemical sanitizing dish machine observed unable to maintain a proper bleach sanitizer concentration. Bleach concentration at time of inspection was <10 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC will discontinue use of dish machine until proper bleach concentration is able to be maintained. PIC set up 3 compartment sink for proper sanitization of all food contact surfaces.
